# AakashMovies

> AakashMovies is a dark cinematic web streaming directory for discovering trending Bollywood, Hollywood, South Indian movies, and Web Series in HD quality.

## Features & Capabilities
- Browse movies by Industry (Bollywood, Hollywood, Tollywood, South Hindi Dubbed, Anime, Punjabi).
- Filter titles by Genre, Language, Release Year, Content Type (Movie / Web Series), and Sort Criteria.
- Detailed Movie & Series pages with Cast, Filmmakers, Synopsis, User Ratings, and Official Availability links.
- Interactive Search with instant auto-suggestions.
- Favorites / Watchlist management for registered users.

## Structure & Pages
- Homepage: /
- Latest Movies Catalog: /movies
- Web Series Catalog: /web-series
- Category & Industry Pages: /category/:slug
- Movie Details: /movie/:slug
- Series Details: /series/:slug
- User Favorites: /favorites
- User Profile: /profile
